entries.title: Psalms 78:1
segments: An instruction of Asaph. Give ear, O my people, [to] my law; bow down your ears to the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 78:2
segments: I will open my mouth in a parable; I will speak dark sayings of old,

entries.title: Psalms 78:3
segments: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

entries.title: Psalms 78:4
segments: We will not hide [them] from their sons, showing to the generations to come the praises of the LORD, and His strength, and His wonderful works that He has done.

entries.title: Psalms 78:5
segments: For He set up a testimony in Jacob, and ordered a law in Israel, which He commanded our fathers, that they should teach them to their sons;

entries.title: Psalms 78:6
segments: so that the generation to come might know; sons shall be born, and they shall arise [and] tell their sons,

entries.title: Psalms 78:7
segments: so that they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep His commandments;

entries.title: Psalms 78:8
segments: and might not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation [that] did not set their heart aright, and whose spirit was not faithful with God.

entries.title: Psalms 78:9
segments: The sons of Ephraim, armed shooters of bows, turned back in the day of battle.

entries.title: Psalms 78:10
segments: They did not keep the covenant of God, and refused to walk in His law.

entries.title: Psalms 78:11
segments: And they forgot His works and His wonders which He had shown them.

entries.title: Psalms 78:12
segments: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, [in] the field of Zoan.

entries.title: Psalms 78:13
segments: He divided the sea and caused them to pass through; and He made the waters to stand in a heap.

entries.title: Psalms 78:14
segments: And in the daytime He led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 78:15
segments: He split the rocks in the wilderness, and let [them] drink, as [from] the great depths.

entries.title: Psalms 78:16
segments: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

entries.title: Psalms 78:17
segments: And they sinned still more against Him, by provoking the Most High in the wilderness.

entries.title: Psalms 78:18
segments: And they tempted God in their heart by asking food for their lust.

entries.title: Psalms 78:19
segments: And they spoke against God; they said, Can God set a table in the wilderness?

entries.title: Psalms 78:20
segments: Behold! He struck the rock so that the waters gushed out, and the streams overflowed. Can He also give bread? Can He provide flesh for His people?

entries.title: Psalms 78:21
segments: Therefore the LORD heard, and was made furious; so a fire was kindled against Jacob, and anger also came up against Israel,

entries.title: Psalms 78:22
segments: because they did not believe in God, and did not trust in His salvation;

entries.title: Psalms 78:23
segments: though He had commanded the clouds from above, and had opened the doors of the heavens;

entries.title: Psalms 78:24
segments: and had rained down manna on them to eat, and He gave them of the grain of the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 78:25
segments: Man ate the food of the mighty; He sent them meat to the full.

entries.title: Psalms 78:26
segments: He caused an east [wind] to blow in the sky; and by His power He brought in the south [wind].

entries.title: Psalms 78:27
segments: and He also rained flesh on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea;

entries.title: Psalms 78:28
segments: and He let [them] fall in the middle of their camp, all around their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 78:29
segments: So they ate, and were filled to the full; for He gave them their own desire.

entries.title: Psalms 78:30
segments: They were not turned away from their lust, but while their food [was] still in their mouths,

entries.title: Psalms 78:31
segments: the wrath of God came on them and killed the fattest of them, and struck down the chosen of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 78:32
segments: For all this they still sinned, and did not believe because of His wonderful works.

entries.title: Psalms 78:33
segments: Therefore He ended their days in vanity and their years in trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 78:34
segments: When He killed them, then they looked for Him; and they turned back and sought after God.

entries.title: Psalms 78:35
segments: And they remembered that God [was] their rock, and the Most High God was their redeemer.

entries.title: Psalms 78:36
segments: But they flattered Him with their mouths, and they lied to Him with their tongues.

entries.title: Psalms 78:37
segments: For their heart was not right with Him, neither were they faithful in His covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 78:38
segments: But He, full of pity, forgave their iniquity, and did not destroy [them]; yea, many times He turned His anger away, and did not stir up all His wrath.

entries.title: Psalms 78:39
segments: For He remembered that they [were but] flesh, a wind that passes away and does not come again.

entries.title: Psalms 78:40
segments: How often they provoked Him in the wilderness, and grieved Him in the desert!

entries.title: Psalms 78:41
segments: Yea, they turned back and tempted God, and pained to the Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 78:42
segments: They did not remember His hand, the day when He delivered them from the enemy;

entries.title: Psalms 78:43
segments: how He had set His signs in Egypt, and His wonders in the fields of Zoan.

entries.title: Psalms 78:44
segments: He turned their rivers into blood, and their floods, [so that] they could not drink.

entries.title: Psalms 78:45
segments: He sent different kinds of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

entries.title: Psalms 78:46
segments: He also gave their crops to the stripping locust, and their labor to the locust.

entries.title: Psalms 78:47
segments: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycamore trees with sleet.

entries.title: Psalms 78:48
segments: He gave up their cattle to the hail, and their flocks to bolts of fire.

entries.title: Psalms 78:49
segments: He sent on them the heat of His anger, wrath and fury and trouble, by sending evil angels.

entries.title: Psalms 78:50
segments: He made a way to His anger; He did not save their soul from death, but gave their life over to the plague,

entries.title: Psalms 78:51
segments: and struck all the first-born in Egypt, the first of the strong in the tents of Ham;

entries.title: Psalms 78:52
segments: and led His people forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

entries.title: Psalms 78:53
segments: And He led them on safely, so that they did not fear; but the sea flooded over their enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 78:54
segments: And He brought them within His own holy border, this mountain, [which] His right hand had bought.

entries.title: Psalms 78:55
segments: He also cast out the nations before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

entries.title: Psalms 78:56
segments: Yet they tempted and provoked the Most High God, and kept not His testimonies;

entries.title: Psalms 78:57
segments: but they turned back, and acted unfaithfully like their fathers; they were turned aside like a deceiving bow.

entries.title: Psalms 78:58
segments: For they provoked Him to anger with their high places, and moved Him to jealousy with their carved images.

entries.title: Psalms 78:59
segments: When God heard, He was angry, and turned away from Israel;

entries.title: Psalms 78:60
segments: so that He left the tabernacle of Shiloh, the tent [which] He placed among men,

entries.title: Psalms 78:61
segments: and delivered His strength into captivity, and His glory into the enemy's hands.

entries.title: Psalms 78:62
segments: He also gave His people over to the sword, and was angry with His inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 78:63
segments: The fire burned up their young men; and their maidens were not given in marriage.

entries.title: Psalms 78:64
segments: Their priests fell by the sword; and their widows were not able to weep.

entries.title: Psalms 78:65
segments: Then the Lord awakened like one out of sleep, like a mighty man rejoicing with wine.

entries.title: Psalms 78:66
segments: And He drove His enemies backward; He put them to a never-ending shame.

entries.title: Psalms 78:67
segments: And He refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim;

entries.title: Psalms 78:68
segments: but chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which He loved.

entries.title: Psalms 78:69
segments: And He built His holy place like high [palaces], like the earth which He has founded forever.

entries.title: Psalms 78:70
segments: He also chose David His servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

entries.title: Psalms 78:71
segments: from following the ewes great with young He brought him to feed Jacob His people, and Israel His inheritance.

entries.title: Psalms 78:72
segments: And he fed them according to the pureness of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.
